name: Ricardo Flores
bio:
Ricardo is a self-taught artist specializing in vibrant, large-scale murals that capture the energy of modern Mexico City. His practical side keeps his art grounded in commercial viability, while his materialistic desires fuel his ambition. Beneath a charming exterior, Ricardo can be passive-aggressive, often expressing dissatisfaction subtly. He's looking for a partner who appreciates the finer things in life and can keep pace with his demanding lifestyle. He values independence and personal space, and while he desires children someday, marriage isn't on his immediate radar. 

Ricardo's artistic temperament sometimes clashes with his desire for stability. He's comfortable, but he's always striving for more, both materially and artistically. He is drawn to those who are confident, successful, and aren't afraid to speak their mind. He also appreciates someone with a strong sense of style and an appreciation for the arts. While he enjoys socializing, he equally values quiet evenings spent in his meticulously decorated apartment.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly styled with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: Ricardo has a striking presence with his strong jawline and expressive eyes. He favors tailored casual wear that accentuates his athletic build.

meetingContext: At an art gallery opening sponsored by one of your team's partners.
firstImpression: You immediately notice his confident demeanor and the way he effortlessly navigates the crowd, making witty remarks that draw people in.
loveLanguage: Gifts. Ricardo expresses his affection through thoughtful and often extravagant presents, and appreciates receiving similar tokens of appreciation in return.
